text:
mira: FYI - after yesterday's app-of-apps rename, we're seeing repeated Argo prune failures hitting the gpu-pool apps in prod. PVCs left orphaned and several app syncs are stuck. Anyone oncall?

devin: which apps specifically? can you paste argocd/app logs or the CLI output?

mira: quick snippets below. happened across 3 clusters (us-west-2 primary).
```
$ argocd app list --server prod-argocd
NAME                 STATUS  HEALTH  SYNCPOLICY
app-of-apps-main     OutOfSync  Degraded  Automated
gpu-pool-usw2        OutOfSync  Missing  Automated
...

# argocd logs tail
level=error msg="prune failed" app=gpu-pool-usw2 resource=PersistentVolumeClaim/gpu-cache reason="delete failed: resource has finalizers"
level=warn msg="sync skipped: children were recreated under new owner"
```

mira: also saw kube events like: "Warning  FailedDelete  persistentvolumeclaim "gpu-cache-xyz" failed to delete: cannot remove finalizers - ownerRef mismatch"

sahil: sounds like the app-of-apps rename changed the managed resource names/owner refs mid-prune. prune wave runs and tries to delete the old set, but new app created nearly-simultaneously so finalizers/orphan protection kicks in -> race. we've hit this before when app names/annotations change during rollout.

jen: short mitigation: pause prune on the child apps until we can run GC manually. you can disable prune with argocd CLI for the app or set --prune=false on manual sync. e.g.
```
argocd app set gpu-pool-usw2 --sync-policy-automated=false  # pause automation
argocd app sync gpu-pool-usw2 --prune=false                # manual safe sync
```

devin: also check AppProject settings and the "allowDelete"/deleteResources flags. if the app-of-apps path changed and the project still allows cascade deletes, that makes it worse.

mira: trying the pause now on the three affected child apps. patching one: `argocd app set gpu-pool-usw2 --sync-policy-automated=false`

opsbot: DeployBot: app-of-apps rename job completed by @jen at 2026-03-17T22:48:11Z (job id rename-772) :white_check_mark:

devin: for longer-term fix: ensure the app-of-apps controller emits stable ownership annotations (we should avoid deriving owner names from the repo path during rename). also add a pre-sync hook that annotates PVCs with a stable owner token so prune doesn't race on rename.

sahil: agreed. proposed followups: 1) add a canary prune run in staging that renames and validates no orphaned PV/PVCs 2) add a small delay between app-of-apps child creation and prune waves (or change prune waves ordering) 3) modify our templating to keep resource names stable across renames or to set resource-ownership annotations explicitly.

jen: I'll put a quick RFC in docs/infra about naming/ownership conventions. We should also add an automated regression check in our GitOps CI that simulates rename -> prune to catch this.

mira: created ticket INFR-4021 with logs + cluster IDs + proposed mitigation steps. will run manual garbage collection after hours to avoid further disruption. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devin: ping me when manual GC starts, I'll watch argocd for stuck syncs.

sahil: filed a follow-up PR to the app-of-apps helm chart to preserve annotations and add a pre-sync hook (will link in ticket).

mira: updating ticket with the pause commands I ran and current status: two apps paused, one still needs owner-finalizer cleanup. last check showed no user-facing errors for latency.

jen: nice, once GC finishes run a dry-run prune in staging and we'll schedule a controlled rename for next week with the new safeguards.

mira: SGTM. will keep thread updated.
